caption: The video captures a small single-engine propeller aircraft performing an aerobatic maneuver against a pale blue sky scattered with soft clouds. Seen first as a dark silhouette and later with green and white coloring, the plane continuously emits a white smoke trail that marks the path it has just flown. Its body orientation rotates in view, swinging from a near-vertical, nose-up attitude into a horizontal, nose-right pose and holding that attitude. Its position drifts leftward and slightly upward, moving from center-left toward the upper-left region. The smoke trail persists the whole time, its earlier steeply descending curve gradually flattening into a thinner, more horizontal line trailing behind the plane. The far end of the trail remains clipped by the left edge as the visible curve rises. The maneuver remains in progress as the view ends.
relations: Plane rotation from vertical to horizontal accompanies a leftward and slightly upward positional drift across the sky.
Continuous smoke emission causes the trail to persist and flatten from a steep curve into a thinner horizontal line.
The plane's upward-leftward movement and rotation reshape the trailing smoke path while its far end remains clipped.
